# Ticket of Eternal Keep 1.3.7 for Minecraft 26.2

This release adds configurable behavior for items enchanted with Curse of Vanishing when a Ticket of Eternal Keeping is consumed.

## Changes

- Tickets now match vanilla `keepInventory` behavior by default: cursed items are preserved after death.
- Server owners can restore the previous behavior by setting `"apply_curse_of_vanishing": true` in `config/ToEK.json`.
- Existing configuration files are updated automatically with the new option set to `false`.
- The setting can be applied without restarting the server by running `/toek reload`.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader
- Java 25

The optional server-side resource pack is included with the GitHub release for vanilla clients that need the custom ticket texture.
